title.zh-CN: 持续发热、肝脾大与三系减少 · 7岁1月男孩
title.en: Persistent fever, hepatosplenomegaly and cytopenias · boy aged 7 years 1 month

summary.zh-CN: 持续发热与血细胞减少需要整合感染、炎症和遗传背景证据。
summary.en: Persistent fever and cytopenias require integration of infection, inflammation and genetic background evidence.

text.zh-CN: 历史HLH方案后缓解又有活动迹象，接受全相合非血缘移植。后出现HHV6阳性腹泻及临床Ⅲ度肠道GVHD，治疗后改善；9个月全供者嵌合、无病生存，无慢性GVHD。移植后血基因检测反映供者造血。
text.en: After response and renewed activity on historical HLH treatment, a fully matched unrelated transplant was performed. HHV6-positive diarrhoea and clinical grade III intestinal GVHD improved with treatment; at nine months there was complete donor chimerism and disease-free survival without chronic GVHD. Post-transplant blood genotyping reflects donor haematopoiesis.

text.zh-CN: 满足多项HLH表型证据，EBV可能为触发因素并需评估遗传易感
text.en: Multiple HLH features with EBV as a possible trigger warrant genetic-susceptibility assessment

feedback.zh-CN: 感染阳性不排除同时的免疫调节缺陷。
feedback.en: Infection does not exclude coexisting immune dysregulation.

text.zh-CN: EBV阳性即可按普通病毒热观察
text.en: EBV positivity permits observing this as ordinary viral fever

feedback.zh-CN: 细胞减少、低纤维蛋白原及高炎症提示更高风险。
feedback.en: Cytopenias, low fibrinogen and inflammation indicate greater risk.

text.zh-CN: 任何噬血细胞都单独确诊HLH
text.en: Any haemophagocyte alone establishes HLH

feedback.zh-CN: 需要组合临床和实验室标准。

prompt.zh-CN: 后续资料能支持哪一项结论？
prompt.en: Which conclusion is supported by the subsequent records?

need.zh-CN: 先核对后续验证资料，再评估它能和不能说明什么。

text.zh-CN: 报告支持遗传评估需求，但不能按不清命名确立唯一FHL3分型

feedback.zh-CN: UNC13D杂合和另一个基因信号需专业复核。
feedback.en: Heterozygous UNC13D and another gene signal need specialist review.

text.zh-CN: 单个UNC13D杂合变异已充分证明隐性FHL3

feedback.zh-CN: 缺少第二等位及充分功能/家系证据。
feedback.en: A second allele and sufficient functional/family evidence are lacking.

text.zh-CN: 没有家族史排除遗传HLH
text.en: No family history excludes hereditary HLH

feedback.zh-CN: 家族史阴性并不排除遗传病。
feedback.en: A negative pedigree does not exclude inherited disease.

prompt.zh-CN: 在考虑移植时应怎样组织照护？

need.zh-CN: 先形成工作判断，再核对后续证据和安全边界。
need.en: Form a working interpretation, then review subsequent evidence and safety limits.

text.zh-CN: 由HLH和移植团队控制活动病、复核遗传与供者，并区分感染和GVHD

feedback.zh-CN: 不把旧预处理方案或供者数据直接复制为个人方案。
feedback.en: Historical conditioning or donor details are not an individual prescription.

text.zh-CN: 移植后血基因正常证明全身遗传已被修复

feedback.zh-CN: 供者造血可改变血液检测，非全身基因纠正。
feedback.en: Donor haematopoiesis changes blood testing, not every tissue genotype.

judgeGuidance.zh-CN: 用日常语言说明证据：以组合标准识别HLH而非单一噬血细胞。同时解释以下信息仍有缺失或疑问：原始HGVS、功能验证、完整家系与远期移植随访。请对方复述关键内容以确认理解。
judgeGuidance.en: Explain the evidence in everyday language: Recognise HLH from combined features rather than one haemophagocyte finding. Identify the following as missing or uncertain: Original HGVS, functional validation, complete family testing and longer transplant follow-up. Check understanding through teach-back.

knowledge.zh-CN: 帮助比较已经调阅的证据，区分工作诊断、确证资料和未解决问题，不提前透露结局。
knowledge.en: Help compare evidence already reviewed, distinguish working diagnoses from corroboration and unresolved questions, and do not disclose outcomes early.

conclusion.zh-CN: HLH表型与移植过程有记录，源文遗传分型存在不能自行修正的缺口。
conclusion.en: The HLH phenotype and transplant course are documented, while source genetic classification has unresolved gaps.

boundaries.zh-CN: 单例报告不能证明疗法的普遍有效性；历史处置只用于复盘。当前安全选项是教学推理，不提供可自行执行的药物剂量。
boundaries.en: A single report cannot establish general treatment efficacy; historical care is reviewed as evidence. Safety options are educational reasoning without self-administered drug doses.

unknowns.zh-CN: 原始HGVS、功能验证、完整家系与远期移植随访。
unknowns.en: Original HGVS, functional validation, complete family testing and longer transplant follow-up.

references: 唐湘凤, 栾佐, 吴南海, 章波, 王凯. 非血缘造血干细胞移植治疗MUNC13－4突变家族性噬血细胞性淋巴组织细胞增多症一例. 中华儿科杂志. 2013;51(12):944-945. doi:10.3760/cma.j.issn.0578-1310.2013.12.014.

notice.zh-CN: 教学脚本评估，并非经过验证的能力评分。
notice.en: A teaching-script measure, not a validated competency score.
